title: Compliance checks: Penalties for digital platform operators — CC/FS98
text:
This factsheet explains the types of penalties HMRC may charge if you do not meet your obligations as a digital platform operator in the UK.

 It also includes information about:

 • where to find guidance on registering with HMRC and your reporting obligations

 • your rights if we’re considering charging you a penalty

 • what happens if you deliberately give us false information

 Factsheets are for guidance only and reflect HMRC’s position at the time of writing.
